description: Motion System Unification and Mobile Polish - Consolidate the fragmented motion/transition system into a single coherent approach. Fix mobile responsiveness issues including text clipping, cramped layouts, and ensure the bottom navigation feels premium. Add meaningful entrance animations for content areas.
steps: Edit frontend/src/styles/interactions.css - Page transition: Keep the ix-page-in-soft keyframe as the single source of truth. Update timing to 380ms (was 460ms - slightly faster feels snappier). Remove the filter: blur(1px) from the animation (it causes performance issues on low-end mobile devices).

Edit frontend/src/styles/interactions.css - Add a new tab-switch transition that is slightly more refined: change ix-tab-content-in timing from 280ms to 250ms and remove the filter: blur(0.5px) for performance.

Edit frontend/src/styles/interactions.css - Refine the press feedback: reduce active scale from 0.97 to 0.98 for subtle elegance (the current 0.97 feels too aggressive for a professional platform). For .btn:active, use scale(0.97) instead of 0.96.

Edit frontend/src/styles/responsive.css - Mobile improvements: (1) At 480px breakpoint, add .page-title { font-size: 20px !important; } to prevent text from being too small. (2) Ensure .metric has min-height: 80px on mobile so content doesn't cramp. (3) Add .grid-auto-260 { grid-template-columns: 1fr !important; } at 640px.

Edit frontend/src/styles/responsive.css - Add smooth scroll-snap behavior for horizontal scrolling sections on mobile: .filter-bar { overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; scroll-snap-type: x proximity; padding-bottom: var(--sp-2); } .filter-bar > * { scroll-snap-align: start; flex-shrink: 0; }

Edit frontend/src/styles/notifications.css - Bottom nav refinement: (1) Increase the icon active background from 24%/14% mix to 18%/10% for subtlety. (2) Remove the translateY(-2px) scale(1.05) on active icon - it creates jank on older devices. Replace with just a background change and color shift. (3) Add will-change: background to .bottom-nav-icon for smooth transitions.

Edit frontend/src/styles/stitch-canonical.css - Remove the duplicate .bottom-nav definition that conflicts with notifications.css. The stitch-canonical version (loaded later in cascade) overrides the notifications.css version with different styling, creating inconsistency. Keep only the notifications.css version as the canonical one. In stitch-canonical.css, remove the entire '/* BOTTOM NAV - glassmorphism mobile navigation bar */' section EXCEPT for the [data-theme='dark'] .bottom-nav override and the @media breakpoint for display:flex.

Edit frontend/src/styles/dashboard.css - Add will-change: transform to .dash-gpa-card, .dash-progress-card, .dash-term-card for smoother hover transitions on mobile. Reduce the welcome card ::before and ::after orb sizes by 30% and slow their animation from 6s/8s to 10s/14s for a calmer feel.

Edit frontend/src/styles/responsive.css - Safe area improvements: Ensure the bottom padding accounts for both safe-area AND bottom-nav height. Add: .content { padding-bottom: calc(var(--sp-12) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)); } at the global level, and at 640px: .content { padding-bottom: calc(88px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)) !important; }
acceptance_criteria: Page transition animation is defined in only one place (interactions.css)
Press feedback uses 0.98 scale (more subtle than 0.97)
Tab content transition has no blur filter
Bottom nav has no conflicting definitions between stitch-canonical and notifications.css
Mobile filter bars can scroll horizontally with snap behavior
Dashboard welcome card orbs are calmer (slower, smaller)
verification: Run: grep -c 'ix-page-in-soft' frontend/src/styles/interactions.css to confirm it exists (should be >= 1)
Run: grep 'scale(0.98)' frontend/src/styles/interactions.css to confirm press scale change
Run: grep 'scroll-snap-type' frontend/src/styles/responsive.css to confirm filter bar scroll
Run: grep -c 'bottom-nav {' frontend/src/styles/stitch-canonical.css to check duplicate removal (should be reduced)
findings: All steps implemented. Page transition reduced to 380ms with blur removed. Tab transition at 250ms with blur removed. Press feedback now 0.98 (was 0.97), .btn:active at 0.97 (was 0.96). Mobile: page-title floor 20px, metric min-height 80px, grid-auto-260 collapses at 640px, filter-bar horizontal scroll-snap added. Bottom-nav in notifications.css refined: accent mix reduced to 18%/10%, translateY/scale jank removed, will-change added. stitch-canonical.css duplicate bottom-nav block fully removed - only dark theme override and display:flex media rule remain. Dashboard cards have will-change:transform. Welcome card orbs reduced 30% (70px/56px) with slower 10s/14s animation. Safe-area bottom padding accounts for bottom-nav at 640px breakpoint.
